senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Bar ʿAshtor, the progenitor of a family of converts.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:4:3">Y. Bicc. I, 64ᵃ</cite> top <he>אילין דבר ע׳ וכ׳</he> those of the family of B. A. who are converts, sons of converts.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:4:3">Ib.</cite> <he>קיימה בנימין בר ע׳ וכ׳</he> one Benjamin B. A. stood before us (was admitted as witness) in the case of &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:4:3">ib.</cite> <he>בר אשתור</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:1:5">Y. Dem. VI, 25ᵇ</cite> top.
